name: Brian Moser

skins.name: Biney
skins.lore: The Biney skin represents the moment Dexter finally recognizes Brian Moser as both the Ice Truck Killer and his biological brother. DEXTER (S1 EP12)

skins.name: Married
skins.lore: The Married skin represents Brian Moser when he tricks Debra Morgan with a fake marriage proposal as part of his plan to kill her. DEXTER (S1 EP12)

skins.name: Casual
skins.lore: The Casual skin represents the moment Brian Moser enters Dexter's father's house and meets Dexter for the 'first time' without revealing his true identity. DEXTER (S1 EP9)

skins.name: Angel
skins.lore: The Angel skin represents Brian Moser attempting to murder Angel Batista while wearing a dark disguise to avoid being identified. DEXTER (S1 EP10)

skins.name: Original Sin
skins.lore: The Original Sin skin represents Brian Moser's appearance in Dexter: Original Sin during his earliest chronological appearance in the Dexter storyline Dexter O.S. (S1 E2).

skins.name: Father Knows Best
skins.lore: The Father Knows Best skin represents Brian Moser dancing to Dexter's deceased father's favorite song. DEXTER (S1 EP9)

skins.name: Hallucination
skins.lore: The Hallucination skin represents Dexter hallucinating Brian Moser in Dexter: Resurrection after killing the dwarf man.

skins.name: Nebreska
skins.lore: The Nebreska skin represents Dexter hallucinating Brian Moser as his 'Dark Passenger'. DEXTER (S6 EP7)

lore: Brian Moser, also known as the Ice Truck Killer, is a serial killer from the television series Dexter. As Dexter Morgan’s biological brother, Brian is intelligent, manipulative, and deeply disturbed, using psychological games and brutal murders to reconnect with Dexter through their traumatic past.
